source:
@@U01540@@
But I know now that nothing
perfect is given to man.
You gave me this rapture that leads me nearer
and nearer to the gods,
but you gave me also the companion
I can’t do without, even though
he degrades me in my own eyes,
cold, impudent, and in a single breath
reduces your gifts to nothingness.
He fans inside me incessantly the raging passion
for that woman’s bewitching image.
So I stagger from desire to pleasure,
and having that,
languish once more for desire.

@@U01542@@
(Entering.)

@@U01543@@
Haven't you had enough of this?
How much longer can it please you?
Trying something once is understandable,
but then it’s time to go on.

@@U01545@@
I wish you had something more to do than
plague me on one of my better days.

@@U01547@@
Oh, well, let’s make no mistake!
I'd gladly just wash my hands of you!
Just be careful not to say that to me in earnest.
You aren't exactly an ideal companion, you know.
You're rude, ill-tempered, and, what’s more, a lunatic.
I’m never done with dealing with you!
Nor can I ever tell from looking at you
what you want and don’t want!

@@U01549@@
Ah! There! Now!
There you've got it!
Just the right tone!
He wants to be thanked for boring me!
translation:
@@U01540@@
但我现在知道没什么
完美是赋予人的。
你给了我这种狂喜，让我更加亲近
也更接近诸神，
但你也给了我伴侣
我不能没有，即使
他在我眼中贬低了我，
冰冷、无礼、一口气
将你的恩赐降为虚无。
他不断地煽动我内心的汹涌激情
为了那个女人的迷人形象。
所以我从欲望到快乐摇摇欲坠，
有了这个，
再次为欲望而憔悴。

@@U01542@@
（进入。）

@@U01543@@
你还没有受够这些吗？
还能让你高兴多久？
尝试一次是可以理解的
但接下来是时候继续了。

@@U01545@@
我希望你有更多的事可做
在我最美好的日子之一困扰着我。

@@U01547@@
哦，好吧，我们不要犯错误！
我很乐意和你洗手！
只是要小心，不要认真地对我说这句话。
你知道，你并不是一个理想的伴侣。
你很粗鲁，脾气暴躁，而且还是一个疯子。
我和你的相处还没有结束！
我也无法从你的眼神中看出
你想要什么和不想要什么！

@@U01549@@
啊！那里！现在！
就这样，你得到了！
语气刚刚好！
他想感谢他让我厌烦了！
